direction: The problem is still fuzzy, but everyone can feel the pain.
Someone needs to talk to users, follow the data, and ship the first useful path.
The AI piece has to survive outside a demo.

points: Built an internal agent platform with memory, MCP, and reusable skills that teammates use for FinOps and cross-team spend questions.
Forecast and cost work with the CTO and engineering leadership that cut $2.9M a year in multi-cloud spend.
Ran a production ML forecast across 400+ services at sub-1% variance; capacity decisions run off it now.
Replaced manual Google Sheets planning with automated 12-month capacity planning, cutting planning cycles from weeks to days.
Architected migration tooling that decommissioned 6+ global datacenters as Box moved from on-premise to multi-cloud.
Built a self-service infrastructure platform for 200+ engineers through Jira integration, reducing provisioning from days to hours.
Replaced per-site monitoring habits with one hardware standard across the global datacenter fleet.
Deployed Sensu-based auto-ticketing for host-down and hardware alerts, cutting critical-alert MTTR by about 90%.
Built data pipelines and reports on Charlotte housing affordability for local policy groups.
Went through Tresata's Scala and Spark data engineering bootcamp.
Finalist in a client hackathon translating stakeholder requirements into product direction.
Shipped a full-stack add-drop service integrated with registrar systems.
Ran ceremonies as Scrum Master for the infrastructure and application teams.
Led a student team building automated data scraping and ETL pipelines.
Designed and taught a web scraping curriculum for 20+ students.
